meaning: Exact fiber-based resolution of d<k cancellation cases in the free A/B retained-neighborhood scan.  For slack-one cases (k-d=1), tests all outside fibers to determine whether any combination of rank-one images spans the required subspace.  A witness is a full rank-22 decomposition verified on all Brent equations; absence excludes all A/B replacements in the given retained-column neighborhood, including cancellation-bearing ones.
